integrations.subtitle: Connect Pure Engage to any app: send data in, get events out, or let an AI assistant help.
integrations.adminOnly: Only admins can set up integrations. Ask an admin to create API keys or webhooks for you.

kpi.keysHint: Revoke any you no longer use

api.title: REST API & keys
api.body: Your developers push contacts, events and consent, trigger journeys and send messages. Each key gets only the permissions it needs.

inbound.title: Inbound webhooks
inbound.body: Any app that can post JSON (a booking system, a form, Zapier) sends data in. Map its fields once, no code needed.

outbound.title: Outbound webhooks
outbound.body: Tell other apps when something happens: opens, clicks, consent changes, journey steps. Signed and retried.

ai.title: AI assistants (MCP)
ai.body: Let Claude or another AI assistant look up results and draft campaigns. It can draft, never send.

nocode.title: Zapier, Make & n8n
nocode.body: Step-by-step recipes for connecting thousands of apps with no-code tools.

import.title: CSV & Excel import
import.body: Upload a file of contacts, map its columns and check every row before anything is saved.

reference.title: API reference
reference.body: Every endpoint, the permission it needs, and ready-to-run examples.

purenet.title: PureNet
purenet.body: The PureNet connector is built against a mock and waits for the PureNet team to confirm the contract.

log.title: Recent requests
log.emptyHint: Calls made with an API key or to an inbound webhook appear here (details of the call only, never the data sent).

api.subtitle: Keys for your own systems. Give each app its own key with only the permissions it needs.
api.emptyHint: Create a key for each system that talks to Pure Engage.
api.quickstartHint: Send your first contact and event. Replace $PE_API_KEY with your key.
api.trackExample: Add a contact and record an event
api.piiWarning: This key can read full names, emails, phone numbers and profile fields. Every read is recorded in the audit log.

inbound.subtitle: Receive data from any app that can post JSON.
inbound.emptyHint: Create one for each app that should send contacts or events.
inbound.editorHint: Paste an example of what the app sends, then point each field at the right place.
inbound.auth: How the app proves it's allowed
inbound.sampleHint: Paste an example with made-up values. It stays in your browser and is never saved.
inbound.recordsOne: The whole payload is one record
inbound.contactHint: Map an external ID or an email so each record is matched to the right contact.
inbound.consentHint: Values like yes/no, true/false, granted/denied and opt-in/opt-out are understood.
inbound.eventToggle: Record an event for each record
inbound.eventHint: Events can start journeys, e.g. appointment.booked.
inbound.eventKeyHint: Stops the same event being recorded twice
inbound.previewEmpty: Paste an example payload to see the contacts and events it creates.
inbound.secretToken: Send it as Authorization: Bearer <secret> (or the X-PE-Token header). Tools that can only set a URL can add ?token=<secret> to it.
inbound.secretHmac: Sign each request with the header X-PE-Signature: t=<unix time>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256 of "t.body" with this secret>.
inbound.urlHintToken: Send the secret as Authorization: Bearer <secret>.
inbound.sendTestHint: Paste an example payload below to send a test.

outbound.emptyHint: Add an endpoint to tell another app when something happens.
outbound.verifyHint: Check X-PE-Signature on every delivery so you only trust requests that really come from Pure Engage.

reference.subtitle: Generated from the live OpenAPI spec, so it always matches the API.

nocode.subtitle: Connect thousands of apps without writing code.
nocode.outTitle: Get events out of Pure Engage
nocode.in1: Create an inbound webhook here and copy its URL and secret.
nocode.in2: In {{tool}}, add the action “{{action}}” with method POST and the webhook URL.
nocode.in3: Add the header Authorization: Bearer <secret> and send the data as JSON.
nocode.in4: Run a test, then come back and map the fields using the example it sent.
nocode.out1: In {{tool}}, start with the trigger “{{action}}” and copy the URL it gives you.
nocode.out2: Add an outbound webhook here with that URL and the events you want (or * for all).
nocode.out3: Press “Send test” so {{tool}} learns what the payload looks like.
nocode.out4: Payloads carry IDs only. Look up details with the API if your flow needs them.
nocode.privacy: Only send the fields a flow needs. Outbound payloads never include profile data, and every call is logged.

ai.subtitle: Connect Claude or another AI assistant over MCP. It can look things up and prepare drafts; people stay in charge of sending.

claude.name: Claude
claude.step1: In Claude, open Settings → Connectors and choose “Add custom connector”.
claude.step2: Name it Pure Engage and paste {{url}}.
claude.step3: Choose Connect, sign in to Pure Engage as an admin and approve what Claude may do.

claudeCode.name: Claude Code
claudeCode.step1: Run the command below in your terminal.
claudeCode.step2: Start Claude Code, run /mcp and choose pure-engage → Authenticate.
claudeCode.step3: Approve the connection in the browser window that opens.

other.name: Other MCP clients
other.step1: Create an API key with the “AI: read only” or “AI: read and draft” preset.
other.step2: Add a remote (Streamable HTTP) MCP server with the URL {{url}}.
other.step3: Send the key as Authorization: Bearer <key>, or let the client sign in with OAuth if it supports it.

ai.can1Hint: Campaign and journey performance, segments and their sizes, recent activity and headline numbers.
ai.can2Hint: Segments, email and SMS templates, and draft campaigns for a person to review.
ai.cannotHint: There is no tool to send, schedule or activate anything. A person launches drafts in the console.
ai.privacyHint: Contact details are masked unless you grant full personal details. Every lookup is in the audit log.
ai.noneHint: Follow the steps above. Connections you approve appear here and can be disconnected at any time.

why.reports_read: See headline numbers, journeys and recent activity.
why.drafts_write: Create segments, templates and draft campaigns for you to review.
